name: ramnagar

grid.originMeaning: UTM metres of the TOP-LEFT CORNER of cell (col 0, row 0)
grid.orientation: north-up; row 0 is the northernmost row; col 0 the westernmost; index = row*width + col

files.name: elevation.i16
files.description: Int16 little-endian metres above the EGM2008 geoid (GLO-30 surface model incl. canopy), row-major from the NORTH row; -32768 = no data

files.name: landcover.u8
files.description: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 class codes, uint8, same layout as elevation; 0 = no data

files.name: assets.json
files.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection in lon/lat: villages (Point), roads (LineString, simplified), water (LineString/Polygon)

compression: none (files are raw; the browser can fetch them directly)

sources.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (COP-DEM_GLO-30, 2021 release)
sources.licence: Copernicus DEM licence (free, including commercial use, with attribution)
sources.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus DEM GLO-30 data (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.
sources.resampling: bilinear (valid neighbours only), geographic -> UTM at cell centres
sources.note: Surface model: includes canopy and buildings; heights are above EGM2008 geoid.

sources.name: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200
sources.attribution: (c) ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium. CC BY 4.0.
sources.resampling: nearest neighbour at cell centres (10 m source -> 30 m cell; no majority filter)
sources.note: Land-cover class, not a fuel model.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.method: OSM API 0.6 map call (Overpass endpoints failed: https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter: URLError <urlopen error [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer>; https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter: HTTPError HTTP Error 500: Internal Server Error; https://overpass.private.coffee/api/interpreter: HTTPError HTTP Error 500: Internal Server Error)

statement: Synthetic inputs: none. Spread rates are not part of this pack; the engine assigns uncalibrated spread assumptions to land-cover classes.
